question: Which canonical slice should own #87711 first: reset lifecycle durability, Telegram delivery diagnostics, or the broader rehydration/compaction state cluster?
rationale: The issue combines a source-visible reset ordering invariant with Telegram delivery symptoms and adjacent compaction fixes, so automation should not pick the product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.body: Make transcript/header creation durable before sessions.json binding, then validate Telegram and cron phantom-binding recovery against that invariant.

options.title: Split into channel and core trackers
options.body: Keep #87711 as the broad cluster and open narrower owners for Telegram delivery proof, reset lifecycle durability, and rehydration/compaction behavior.

options.title: Wait for live repro only

recommendation.title: Prioritize reset durability
recommendation.body: Make transcript/header creation durable before sessions.json binding, then validate Telegram and cron phantom-binding recovery against that invariant.
